claims.claim: States in134Pr populated via119Sn(19F,4n)134Pr; RDDS at87MeV and DSAM at83MeV with Euroball, inner BGO ball, Cologne plunger; reduced transition probabilities compared to TQPTR and IBFFM.
claims.boundary: Focus is two positive-parity candidate partner bands; not a whole-nucleus survey.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: Results do not support static chirality in134Pr and emphasize shape fluctuations; intrinsic chirality if present has dynamical character with nuclear system fluctuating between chiral and achiral configurations.
claims.boundary: Does not claim total impossibility of dynamic chirality; author suggests two-quasiparticle coupling to shape degrees of freedom may be the prominent mechanism.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: Spontaneous breaking of chiral symmetry proposed when mutually perpendicular angular momenta of valence protons, neutrons, core align along short, long, intermediate axes of triaxial core; leads to near-degenerate doublet bands of same parity.
claims.boundary: This is the model paradigm being tested, not a proved experimental premise.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: 134Pr first reported near-degenerate same-parity bands Ref4,5 crossing above I>15hbar; IBFFM Ref6 gave alternative interpretation attributing yrast band to triaxial core ground state and yrare band to gamma band/higher collective core components.
claims.boundary: Prior degeneracy observation does not equal measured transition strengths.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: Vivitron accelerator at IReS Strasbourg. RDDS: 87MeV, 0.5 mg/cm² 119Sn on 1.8 mg/cm² 181Ta foil facing beam, recoil v=.98(2)% c stopped in 6.0 mg/cm² Au. DSAM: 83MeV, 0.7 mg/cm² 119Sn on 9.5 mg/cm² 181Ta backing.
claims.boundary: Two separate runs and targets; stopping media differ (Au vs Ta).
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: Euroball IV array plus inner BGO ball; coincidence trigger required >=3 gamma in Ge cluster/clover segments and >=3 segments in inner ball; standard add-back for Compton scattering.
claims.boundary: No individual clover efficiency curves or angle-dependent response kernels supplied.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: RDDS data taken at 20 target-to-stopper distances from electrical contact to 2500 micrometers; standard DDCM with gates on shifted and unshifted components below level of interest; lifetime tau calculated using peak areas within sensitivity region.
claims.boundary: DDCM avoids unobserved feeding dependence in ideal gating; raw peak areas not published.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: DSAM line shapes treated by DDCM using Monte Carlo simulation of recoil slowing-down with modified DESASTOP.
claims.boundary: Stopping power and velocity profile details rely on code references.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: Lifetimes of Band1 10+ to 18+ and Band2 13+ to 17+ deduced; all determined for first time except 10+1 which agrees with Klemme1999 Ref13.
claims.boundary: All reported quantities are tau(ps), mean lifetimes.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: Lifetimes for 14+1 and 15+2 determined from both RDDS and DSAM in very good agreement within error; DSAM reported due to higher statistical significance.
claims.boundary: Shows overlap between methods for two states; raw separate values not tabulated.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: Euroball clover rings used as Compton polarimeter. Delayed component of 306keV doublet confirmed E1 as in Roberts2003 Ref14. Directional correlation and linear polarization assign M1 with negligible E2 to ΔI=1 intraband transitions; ΔI=2 intraband and interband show E2 character.
claims.boundary: Polarization confirms multipolarity character qualitatively; detailed polarization coefficients are deferred to forthcoming paper.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: Text explicitly states: Details of the lifetime analysis, branching ratios and linear polarizations coefficients will be reported in a forthcoming publication [15] (Tonev et al., to be published).
claims.boundary: Tonev2006 PRL itself does not publish the complete numerical branching ratio table, polarization numbers, or covariance matrix.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: In the 14+–19+ near-degeneracy region, experimental intraband B(E2) values for Band1 are a factor of 2 to 3 larger than those of Band2.
claims.boundary: Plotted B(E2) are derived from measured tau and revised branching ratios; exact numbers are in Fig3 plots, not TableI.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: Experimental B(M1) values in both partner bands behave similarly within uncertainties and indicate relatively strong transition strengths; no pronounced staggering observed in either band.
claims.boundary: Absence of M1 staggering contrasts with symmetric static chiral prediction.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: B(M1)/B(E2) ratios from lifetime data agree with intensity results of Ref4, differing only at 13+1 and 15+1 from Ref16; corresponding ratios for the two bands differ in all measurements; no staggering in Band1.
claims.boundary: Revises earlier branching interpretations; confirms partner bands have different B ratios.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: Results are incompatible with static chirality where intraband B(E2) transition strengths must be almost equal; nucleus stays in very soft vibrational regime.
claims.boundary: Rejection applies to the static/rigid chiral limit.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: TQPTR assumes rigid triaxial core with cranking inertia ratios Js:Ji:Jl = 1.52:3.55:1; predicts transition from dynamic to static chirality, giving equalizing B(E2), increasing B(E2) with spin, and pronounced B(M1) staggering above 12+; all in clear disagreement with experiment.
claims.boundary: TQPTR model fails to reproduce experimental behavior.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: IBFFM couples proton and neutron to triaxial core with cubic IBA term generating triaxial equilibrium with shape fluctuations fixed by 134Ce data; predicts larger B(E2) difference between bands, cancels M1 staggering, and reproduces nearly constant B(E2) trend.
claims.boundary: IBFFM matches experimental trends better, supporting role of shape fluctuations.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: Static chirality corresponds to weak overlap/tunneling between left- and right-handed sectors (equal transition strengths); dynamic chirality corresponds to large overlap (unequal transition strengths with opposite sign matrix elements due to orthogonality).
claims.boundary: Author’s theoretical formulation of the difference between static and dynamic chiral regimes.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: Assumption of gamma=30° in TQPTR gives B(E2)=0 at low spin when rotational axis lies in s-l plane; admixture of near-axial shapes in IBFFM increases low-spin B(E2) to observed nearly constant level.
claims.boundary: Model explanation for why rigid triaxiality fails on B(E2) slope.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: Better IBFFM match supports interpretation of Ref6 where yrast band is predominantly core ground state while yrare band contains major gamma-band component; does not necessarily contradict chiral interpretation because TQPTR Ref19 had similar composition.
claims.boundary: Connects IBFFM core states with chiral wave function composition.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: Petrache2006 Ref9 cites Tonev AIP764(2005)93 and PRL96,052501(2006) (this paper) for 134Pr lifetimes; Petrache2006 Ref11 (Starosta et al., to be published) provided the separate branching data for two-band mixing; Tonev Ref15 is a different to-be-published paper.
claims.boundary: Confirms exact bibliographic mapping; PE06 is a critical analysis using these lifetimes and Ref11 branches, not an independent re-measurement.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons

claims.claim: Starosta2001 source page text saying chirality was strictly negated by Tonev2006 and Petrache2006 overstates source; Tonev concludes static chirality is not supported while dynamic chirality or shape-degree coupling remains open.
claims.boundary: Flagged for downstream targeted maintenance.
claims.lineage: Tonev2006 experimental primary with TQPTR/IBFFM comparisons
